verdict.rationale: Ramp documents dynamic, role-based approval routing (parallel workflows across finance/IT/legal/security) and invoice-to-payment flows that route for approval and pay with minimal clicks, plus granular approvals:write/role-based OAuth scopes and entity-level restrictions supporting configurable approver permissions. Community testimony corroborates a one-click approve-and-fund experience ('click a few buttons... get approval and have the funds transferred. Boom easy'). Missing for 10: dedicated admin-UI walkthrough for assigning specific teammates as approvers, and independent verification of the exact one-click payment-send step beyond marketing copy.
